summary: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. reported that its U.S. subsidiary PERC Water Corporation executed the Central Coast Blue AWPF Design-Build Agreement with the City of Pismo Beach, California, for an advanced water purification facility in Grover Beach. The fixed design-build price is approximately $39.8 million, awarded after a public two-step competitive procurement, covering design, construction, commissioning, warranties and 600 training hours. Initial capacity targets roughly 500 acre-feet per year, with optional Phase 2 expansion to 750 acre-feet not in current scope. This is an ordinary commercial contract, not a special situation; watch execution, change orders and cost-overrun risk.
